references.text: The introduction to the list of men who are to divide the land, where the Lord gives Moses command regarding who shall distribute the inheritance
Moses conveys the Lord's command that the land is to be divided as an inheritance by lot among the nine and a half tribes
The fulfillment of the command where the priest Eleazar, Joshua, and the tribal leaders distribute the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan
The conclusion of the division of the land where Eleazar, Joshua, and the tribal leaders distributed the inheritances by lot at Shiloh
Joshua is appointed to lead Israel into the land and give it to them as an inheritance, in accordance with the Lord's command
Moses gives Joshua the task of leading the people into the land that the Lord has promised them
